title: Heroes of the Storm Hotfix Notes

sections.name: 머리말
sections.html: We just released a new patch for Heroes of the Storm in order to apply a few bug fixes.

sections.name: Bug Fixes
sections.html:
AI

  • Heroes: Fixed a bug that could cause AI Heroes to walk through an enemy base, rather than path around it, when attempting to escape in a lane.
  • Minions and Mercenaries: Fixed an issue causing Minions and Mercenaries to ignore some summoned units, including:
    • Gazlowe’s Rock-It! Turrets
    • Probius’ Photon Cannons
    • Tychus’ Drakken Laser Drill

Battlegrounds

  • Infernal Shrines: Punishers in mid lane will no longer occasionally become stuck prior to reaching the enemy Keep.
  • Volskaya Foundry: A Mercenary Camp’s respawn timer will no longer suddenly appear and begin counting down if that camp has only been partially cleared.

Heroes, Abilities, and Talents

  • Brightwing: Phase Shift will no longer be placed on full cooldown when interrupted by Root, Silence, or Polymorph effects.
  • D.Va: Will no longer become permanently stuck after colliding with Structures or Terrain after using Boosters.
  • Diablo: The Devastating Charge Talent will now correctly apply its bonus damage to enemies stunned by Shadow Charge.
  • Falstad: Tailwind’s Movement Speed buff will now correctly be placed on cooldown after taking damage.
  • Gazlowe: Rock-It! Turrets will now correctly grant allied vision of the area around their placement locations.
  • Lt. Morales: Fixed an issue which allowed the Medivac to move toward and pick up allied Heroes on the way to its intended destination.
